stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,ast_module AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,ast_op AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,ast_value_repr AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS cls,CAST(NULLIF(ast_level,'') AS INTEGER) AS level FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM a p JOIN a arguments ON arguments.__path=p.__path AND arguments.id=p.parent AND arguments.kind='arguments' JOIN functions f ON f.__path=arguments.__path AND f.id=arguments.parent WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: optimizer_imports
stages.query: SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN n.kind='ImportFrom' THEN n.module ELSE alias.name END imported,coalesce(alias.position,0) ordinal FROM a n LEFT JOIN a alias ON alias.__path=n.__path AND alias.parent=n.id AND alias.kind='alias' AND n.kind='Import' WHERE n.kind='Import' OR n.kind='ImportFrom' AND n.level=0

stages.name: optimizer_files
stages.query: SELECT n.*,rx_replace(n.__path,'^.*/','') basename,rx_matches(n.__path,'(?:^|/)l2065_plan_core/') core,1+length(text)-length(replace(text,char(10),'')) line_count FROM (SELECT a.*,CASE WHEN (SELECT entry FROM optimizer_contract)='scan_file' THEN source_text(__path) ELSE replace(replace(source_text(__path),char(13)||char(10),char(10)),char(13),char(10)) END text FROM a WHERE kind='Module') n

stages.name: pass_classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,(SELECT v.name FROM a stmt JOIN a target ON target.__path=stmt.__path AND target.parent=stmt.id AND target.field='target' AND target.kind='Name' AND target.name='phase' JOIN a v ON v.__path=stmt.__path AND v.parent=stmt.id AND v.field='value' AND v.kind='Attribute' WHERE stmt.__path=n.__path AND stmt.parent=n.id AND stmt.kind='AnnAssign' ORDER BY stmt.id LIMIT 1) declared_phase FROM classes n WHERE n.parent=0 AND substr(n.name,-4)='Pass' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a base WHERE base.__path=n.__path AND base.parent=n.id AND base.field='bases' AND base.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND base.name='Protocol')

stages.name: pipeline_entries
stages.query: SELECT tuple.__path,tuple.parent assignment,call.position,CASE cls.declared_phase WHEN 'NORMALIZE' THEN 0 WHEN 'ANALYZE' THEN 1 WHEN 'PHYSICAL' THEN 2 END phase FROM a tuple JOIN calls call ON call.__path=tuple.__path AND call.parent=tuple.id AND call.field='elts' AND call.callee_kind='Name' JOIN pass_classes cls ON cls.__path=call.__path AND cls.name=call.callee WHERE tuple.kind='Tuple' AND tuple.field='value' AND cls.id=(SELECT max(p.id) FROM pass_classes p WHERE p.__path=cls.__path AND p.name=cls.name AND p.id<tuple.id)

OR n.imported='io' OR substr(n.imported,1,3)='io.' OR n.imported='socket' OR substr(n.imported,1,7)='socket.' OR n.imported='subprocess' OR substr(n.imported,1,11)='subprocess.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-002:'||(n.id+n.ordinal*0.001) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id+n.ordinal*0.001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM optimizer_imports n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE NOT (n.imported='os' OR substr(n.imported,1,3)='os.' OR n.imported='io' OR substr(n.imported,1,3)='io.' OR n.imported='socket' OR substr(n.imported,1,7)='socket.' OR n.imported='subprocess' OR substr(n.imported,1,11)='subprocess.' OR n.imported='sqlite3' OR substr(n.imported,1,8)='sqlite3.' OR n.imported='asyncio' OR substr(n.imported,1,8)='asyncio.' OR n.imported='threading' OR substr(n.imported,1,10)='threading.' AND file.core AND (n.imported='l2070_batching' OR substr(n.imported,1,15)='l2070_batching.' OR n.imported='impl.common.l2070_server_plan' OR substr(n.imported,1,30)='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.' OR n.imported='impl.common.l2066_plan_optimizer' OR substr(n.imported,1,33)='impl.common.l2066_plan_optimizer.') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-003' AS issue,'Only adapter.py may import legacy layer '||(char(39)||n.imported||char(39))||'. Fix by routing legacy step data through LegacyStepAdapter so the pass pipeline sees only AnnotatedPlanNode/RelationSchema/EffectSummary.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-003:'||(n.id+n.ordinal*0.001) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id+n.ordinal*0.001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM optimizer_imports n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE NOT (n.imported='os' OR substr(n.imported,1,3)='os.' OR n.imported='io' OR substr(n.imported,1,3)='io.' OR n.imported='socket' OR substr(n.imported,1,7)='socket.' OR n.imported='subprocess' OR substr(n.imported,1,11)='subprocess.' OR n.imported='sqlite3' OR substr(n.imported,1,8)='sqlite3.' OR n.imported='asyncio' OR substr(n.imported,1,8)='asyncio.' OR n.imported='threading' OR substr(n.imported,1,10)='threading.' stages.name: optimizer_findings_1
stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-011' AS issue,'Second dotted-ref parser detected. The only dotted-ref parsing lives in scope.py. Use ref_binding_id() for the binding part or PlanScope.resolve_dotted() for full resolution.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-011:'||(n.id) AS identity,1 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM calls n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE file.basename!='scope.py' AND n.callee_kind='Attribute' AND n.callee IN ('partition','rpartition','rsplit','split') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a arg WHERE arg.__path=n.__path AND arg.parent=n.id AND arg.field='args' AND (arg.position=0 AND arg.kind='Constant' AND arg.value='.')) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-012' AS issue,'Parallel table-keyed binding map '||(char(39)||n.name||char(39))||' is forbidden. The legacy *_cte_by_table side maps caused the out-of-scope-ref bug class. Bind relations in PlanScope and resolve them by BindingId instead.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-012:'||(owner.id+n.position*0.001) AS identity,1 AS phase,owner.id+n.position*0.001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM a n JOIN a owner ON owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=n.parent JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.kind='Name' AND n.field IN ('target','targets') AND owner.kind IN ('Assign','AnnAssign') AND substr(n.name,-9)='_by_table' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-012' AS issue,'Parallel table-keyed binding map '||(char(39)||n.name||char(39))||' is forbidden. The legacy *_cte_by_table side maps caused the out-of-scope-ref bug class. Bind relations in PlanScope and resolve them by BindingId instead.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-012:'||(n.fn+n.id*0.000001) AS identity,1 AS phase,n.fn+n.id*0.000001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM parameters n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.field IN ('posonlyargs','args','kwonlyargs') AND substr(n.name,-9)='_by_table' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-020' AS issue,'Comparison against shape literal '||operand.value_repr||'. Use the typed Cardinality lattice (Cardinality.COUNT etc.) instead of string role/tag comparisons; only adapter.py may translate legacy strings.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-020:'||(n.id+operand.id*0.000001) AS identity,2 AS phase,n.id+operand.id*0.000001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM a n JOIN a operand ON operand.__path=n.__path AND operand.parent=n.id AND operand.field IN ('left','comparators') AND operand.kind='Constant' JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE file.basename!='adapter.py' AND n.kind='Compare' AND operand.value IN ('count','count_only','exists')

stages.name: optimizer_findings_2
stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-021' AS issue,'String literal '||n.value_repr||' looks like a legacy *_count sibling ref. Counts are Cardinality.COUNT relations with one typed `count` column; use RelationSchema.count() instead of suffix-derived refs.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-021:'||(n.id) AS identity,2 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM a n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.kind='Constant' AND n.value_kind='str' AND rx_matches(n.value,'_count\z') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-021' AS issue,'f-string constructs a *_count sibling ref. Counts are Cardinality.COUNT relations; use RelationSchema.count() instead of suffix-derived refs.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-021:'||(n.id) AS identity,2 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM a n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.kind='JoinedStr' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a part WHERE part.__path=n.__path AND part.parent=n.id AND part.field='values' AND (part.kind='Constant' AND part.value_kind='str' AND rx_matches(part.value,'_count\z'))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-022' AS issue,'Set intersection on names is forbidden in the v2 optimizer. Derive schemas through overlay_schema()/project_schema()/union_schema() so type hints and provenance are preserved.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-022:'||(n.id) AS identity,2 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM a n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.kind='BinOp' AND n.op='BitAnd' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls call WHERE call.__path=n.__path AND call.parent=n.id AND call.field IN ('left','right') AND call.callee_kind='Name' AND call.callee IN ('set','frozenset')) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-022' AS issue,'.intersection() on column names is forbidden in the v2 optimizer. Derive schemas through overlay_schema()/project_schema()/union_schema() so type hints and provenance are preserved.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-022:'||(n.id) AS identity,2 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM calls n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.callee_kind='Attribute' AND n.callee='intersection'

stages.name: optimizer_findings_3
stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-023' AS issue,'ColumnSchema() called with bare string column id '||arg.value_repr||'. Wrap it in ColumnId(...) so the type checker can track column identity.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-023:'||(n.id) AS identity,2 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM calls n JOIN a arg ON arg.__path=n.__path AND arg.parent=n.id AND arg.field='args' AND arg.position=0 AND arg.kind='Constant' AND arg.value_kind='str' JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.callee_kind='Name' AND n.callee='ColumnSchema' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-030' AS issue,'Model introspection '||(char(39)||n.name||char(39))||' is forbidden in the v2 optimizer. Producer contracts are authoritative: fail closed with AdapterContractError and fix the producing step''s contract instead of reconstructing it.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-030:'||(n.id) AS identity,3 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM a n JOIN optimizer_files file ON file.__path=n.__path WHERE n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND n.name IN ('get_type_hints','model_fields','model_json_schema','model_sql_column_type_hints') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-031' AS issue,'raise in '||(f.name)||'() has no repair hint. Every v2 error message must say what is wrong and how to fix it (e.g. start a sentence with Fix/Use/Add/Project/Bind describing the repair).' AS message,n.id||':PV2-031:'||(f.id*1000000+n.id) AS identity,3 AS phase,f.id*1000000+n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM functions f JOIN a n ON n.__path=f.__path AND n.id BETWEEN f.id AS message,n.id||':PV2-050:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM registered_invariants n WHERE source_text('docs/design/PLAN_OPTIMIZER_V2_INVARIANTS.md') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM doc_codes d WHERE d.__path='docs/design/PLAN_OPTIMIZER_V2_INVARIANTS.md' AND d.code=n.invariant) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'PV2-052' AS issue,'Invariant code '||n.invariant_repr||' is never cited as ''('||(n.invariant)||')'' in a verifier error message. Add the code citation to the corresponding PlanVerificationError message so failures map back to the registry.' AS message,n.id||':PV2-052:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM registered_invariants n WHERE source_text('docs/design/PLAN_OPTIMIZER_V2_INVARIANTS.md') IS NOT NULL AND instr(source_text(n.__path),'('||n.invariant||')')=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'docs/design/PLAN_OPTIMIZER_V2_INVARIANTS.md' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,1 line,'PV2-050' issue,'Missing invariants design doc '||'docs/design/PLAN_OPTIMIZER_V2_INVARIANTS.md'||'. Add the doc listing every OPTIMIZER_INVARIANTS code with its description and repair hint.' message,'missing-document' identity,0 phase,0 ordering,'' symbol,'' sort_name WHERE NOT (source_text('docs/design/PLAN_OPTIMIZER_V2_INVARIANTS.md') IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT d.__path path,0 start_byte,length(CAST(source_text(d.__path) AS BLOB)) end_byte,1 line,'PV2-051' issue,'Doc lists invariant code '||(char(39)||d.code||char(39))||' that is not registered in OPTIMIZER_INVARIANTS. Remove the stale doc row or register the invariant in '||'impl/common/l2065_plan_core/verifier.py'||'.' message,d.code identity,0 phase,0 ordering,'' symbol,'' sort_name FROM doc_codes d WHERE d.__path='docs/design/PLAN_OPTIMIZER_V2_INVARIANTS.md' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM registered_invariants r WHERE r.invariant=d.code) GROUP BY d.__path,d.code
